$comment: Every entry must state WHY the match is not a secret. An allowlist entry is a
reviewed decision, not a way to make CI green: the value is the reason.
Entries are keyed by rule id, then by repository path (as printed by the scanner).
Do not paste credential-shaped literals into these reasons — this file is itself scanned.
Re-review an entry whenever the listed file changes.

db-connection-string..github/workflows/ci.yml: Disposable CI service container: a local ephemeral GitHub runner PostgreSQL with the well-known default superuser password. No production host, no real credential.
db-connection-string..github/workflows/watchtower.yml: Disposable CI service container: a local ephemeral GitHub runner PostgreSQL with the well-known default superuser password. No production host, no real credential.
db-connection-string.game/docs/DB_RUNBOOK.md: Documentation examples pointing at localhost with placeholder hosts. Reviewed 2026-09-28: no real hostname and no production credential.
db-connection-string.LOCAL_MAC_RUNBOOK.md: Step-by-step local runbook for a developer laptop. Every connection string is loopback (127.0.0.1) against a throwaway Docker container whose password is the literal word localdev, created and destroyed by the same commands. No real host, no production credential. Reviewed 2026-10-08.
db-connection-string.LOCAL_PRESALE_PLAY.md: Manual devnet walkthrough for a developer laptop. The connection strings are loopback (127.0.0.1) against the throwaway Docker Postgres created by the same runbook, with the throwaway role password from db:roles. No real host, no production credential. Reviewed 2026-10-08.
db-connection-string.game/scripts/db-roles.ts: Source comment showing the CLI argument shape with an ellipsis placeholder for the password. Not a credential.
db-connection-string.game/tests/db/gameops-unit.test.ts: Loopback test database URL with a throwaway password that exists only for the duration of the test run.
db-connection-string.watchtower/docs/local-postgres-without-d: Documentation example for a local PostgreSQL container. Localhost only; nothing leaves the machine.

helius-key-in-url.game/apps/backend/tests/security.test.ts: Negative test fixture for the RPC URL redactor: the key is the literal word SECRET123.
helius-key-in-url.game/apps/web/.env.production: NOT ALLOWLISTED — a real Helius devnet API key was committed and later deleted; deletion does not remove it from Git history. Revoke/rotate with the owner and treat historical copies as exposed. No history rewrite is authorized or performed.

password-assignment.game/apps/backend/tests/colony-routes.te: Test fixture: a constant named SESSION_SIGNING_KEY_FOR_TESTS whose value is the literal phrase test-only-colony-session-secret-32-bytes. It exists so the test can sign a session cookie locally; nothing reads it outside the test process and it matches no real secret. Reviewed 2026-11-05.
password-assignment.game/apps/backend/tests/colony-wallet-au: Test fixture: the same SESSION_SIGNING_KEY_FOR_TESTS literal (test-only-colony-session-secret-32-bytes) used to sign a throwaway session in-memory. Not a credential. Reviewed 2026-11-05.

solana-base58-secret.game/README.md: Solana transaction signature (88 base58 characters) for the devnet redeploy. A signature is public data and is not key material.
solana-base58-secret.game/scripts/legacy-recovery-audit.mjs: Historical blobs of this file contained the same public devnet deploy transaction signature 29V5… that is allowlisted in game/README.md (the constant was removed from the current file; the script now reads its config). A signature is public data, not key material. If a future diff adds a real keypair array to this path, it will be caught by the solana-keypair-array rule, which is not allowlisted.
solana-base58-secret.WATCHTOWER_HANDOFF.md: Watchtower handoff report. The 88-character base58 strings are public finalized devnet transaction signatures cited as read-only evidence (sections B/D). Signatures are public chain data, not key material; the file intentionally contains no keys and no secrets. Reviewed 2026-10-06.
solana-base58-secret.watchtower/events/event-catalog.json: Machine-readable event catalog. The 88-character base58 strings are public finalized devnet transaction signatures used as evidence for verified_runtime event types. Public chain data, not key material. Reviewed 2026-10-06.
solana-base58-secret.watchtower/events/runtime-evidence.json: Read-only devnet evidence summary. The 88-character base58 strings are public finalized devnet transaction signatures and the fixtures' file names. Public chain data, not key material. Reviewed 2026-10-06.

Public finalized chain data of a beta test transaction; no keypairs, no credentials, no PII. Reviewed 2026-10-06.
